sdk_methods.name: videos.create_chapter

sdk_methods.name: videos.delete_chapter
constraints: Checks dataset-item/chapter relationship and project management authority; deletes metadata, returns empty 204 and does not delete source media.

sdk_methods.name: videos.download_chunk
constraints: Requires a typed ready descriptor with an absolute signed URL. No descriptor refresh or polling. Uses no platform credentials, accepts full HTTP 200 only, validates available byte size and atomically replaces destination; failures preserve the old file.
sdk_methods.indirect_note: This method also streams from a returned or presigned URL; that URL has no fixed route in the catalog.

sdk_methods.name: videos.download_frame
constraints: Requires a typed ready descriptor with an absolute signed URL. No descriptor refresh or polling. Uses no platform credentials, accepts full HTTP 200 only, validates available byte size and atomically replaces destination; failures preserve the old file.

sdk_methods.name: videos.frame_timetable
constraints: Python from_frame/to_frame map to HTTP from/to. Source is ffprobe or estimated; unavailable metadata returns 503. No implicit conditional-cache or polling behavior.

sdk_methods.name: videos.manifest
domain_effects: This GET may create/persist video segments; segment reads can reconcile expired leases.
constraints: Use the namespace's dataset_item_id or task_id, not an interchangeable UUID. Signed media URLs are temporary; refresh the descriptor after expiry.

sdk_methods.name: videos.prefetch_frames
constraints: Queues missing/failed frames for 1–500 requested indexes; the server deduplicates/sorts and validates actual video bounds. Acknowledgement is not generation completion.

sdk_methods.name: videos.retry_frames
constraints: Up to 500 indexes; empty retries matching failed frames, force clears selected cache objects and regenerates. Task-scoped retry requires annotations:write; dataset-item retry currently checks visible-task access only. No automatic POST retry.

sdk_methods.name: videos.segments
domain_effects: This GET may create/persist video segments; segment reads can reconcile expired leases.
constraints: Use the namespace's dataset_item_id or task_id, not an interchangeable UUID. Signed media URLs are temporary; refresh the descriptor after expiry.

sdk_methods.name: videos.update_chapter
constraints: The chapter must belong to this dataset item and the actor must manage its project. Only explicit fields are sent; the server validates the merged interval and duplicate ranges. No revision/CAS token exists.
